key_findings: DOI 10.1086/684032 resolves to 'Ethnic Composition and Friendship Segregation' (Smith, McFarland, Van Tubergen & Maas, AJS 121(4):1223-1272, 2016); the audit brief title 'The Social Structure of Mobility: Does Even a Large Sample Provide Reliable Estimates?' does not correspond to any real article by these authors (checked Crossref, OpenAlex, web search).

Identified the actual human FLoRA reproduction: Gereke, Kretschmer, Winter & Zhang (2019) 'Reproduction (without author data)', OSF project 'nekdp' (DOI 10.17605/osf.io/nekdp); downloaded code (R scripts), preregistration, codebook, and SCORE report via files.osf.io.

Independent recomputation NOT possible: analysis data are the licensed/gated CILS4EU wave-1 full dataset (accessible only via GESIS Secure Data Center); raw data and network-level meta-analysis inputs cannot be shared.
Headline claim of the paper: classrooms with a larger share of natives show less ethnic homophily (Table 3 Model 2: 'Proportion natives' b=-0.51, SE=0.06, p<.001).
Human reproduction reports a SUCCESSFUL reproduction: b=-0.47 (SE=0.07, p<.001), statistically significant and same-signed across all six robustness specifications.

Reproduction team documented bugs in the original code: missing origin/gender recoded as native/female; ERGM loop misassignment causing double-counting on failed runs; code-vs-paper inclusion criteria mismatch (no participant-share filter, min 3 vs 2 per group).
Version drift: CILS4EU v1.2.0 vs v1.1.0 (ISEI changed), ergm 3.10.4 vs 3.1-0; missing-data handling and covariate centering differed.
notes: Data could not be obtained to independently re-run (gated licensing), so grade is NODATA for independent recomputation even though the reproduction CODE was obtained. This is an environmental/data-access limitation, not a refutation. The human FLoRA reproduction (Gereke et al. 2019) was reported successful and supports the headline claim numerically (b=-0.47 vs -0.51), so the paper's core directional finding reproduces in the human attempt despite documented code bugs. OSF API v2 was down (HTTP 503) all session; used waterbutler v1 to download reproduction materials. No paywalled article PDF retained.
